_comment: Spells. Cost is paid from the player's Aether. target: unit_ally | unit_enemy | ground | self. Effects: heal, damage, shield (absorbs damage), summon. 'radius' > 0 makes an area effect. 'drain' heals the caster by that share of damage dealt. vfx picks the visual.

ward.name: Aether Ward
ward.description: Shields an ally, absorbing 60 damage for 15s.

life_drain.name: Life Drain
life_drain.description: Drains 22 life from an enemy to heal the Necromancer.

fireball.name: Alchemic Fire
fireball.description: A flask of alchemical fire: 60 fire damage in a 2-tile radius.

mass_ward.name: Imperial Aegis
mass_ward.description: Shields every ally within 5 tiles, absorbing 50 damage each for 12s.

death_coil.name: Death Coil
death_coil.description: Deals 90 curse damage; the Sovereign heals for half.

wagenburg.name: Wagenburg
wagenburg.description: Deploy into a wagon fort (or pack up to move again).

ram.name: Ram
ram.description: Rams an enemy ship (it must be another ship) for massive damage.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description: Drags an enemy within 6 tiles into melee and hurts it.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.description: Deals 45 damage to enemies within 3.5 tiles and slows them by 45% for 5s.

bombardment.name: Bombardment
bombardment.description: Shells an area: 80 fire damage within 2.5 tiles, buildings included.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: Heals every ally within 6 tiles for 60.

inoculation.name: Inoculation
inoculation.description: Heals every ally within 6 tiles for 80 (she championed smallpox inoculation).

crimson_lance.name: Crimson Lance
crimson_lance.description: Deals 110 curse damage and heals Morvana for all of it.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood_frenzy.description: Heals every ally within 6 tiles for 60.

bone_wall.name: Bone Wall
bone_wall.description: Shields every ally within 5 tiles, absorbing 70 damage each for 12s.

full_steam.name: Full Steam
full_steam.description: Opens the boilers: +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

soul_furnace.name: Soul Furnace
soul_furnace.description: Feeds bottled souls to the engine: +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

aether_bomb.name: Aether Bomb
aether_bomb.description: Drops an Aether bomb: 45 fire damage within 1.5 tiles, buildings included.

plague_drop.name: Plague Drop
plague_drop.description: Releases a plague cloud: 8 damage per second to enemies inside for 8s.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: Tesla's gauntlet: 70 Aether damage, jumping to up to 4 more enemies (20% less each jump).

death_ray.name: Death Ray
death_ray.description: Tesla's teleforce beam: 260 Aether damage to one target.

escape.name: Great Escape
escape.description: Houdini vanishes and reappears up to 7 tiles away.

steam_flame.name: Imperial Flame
steam_flame.description: The Iron Emperor's flamethrower arm: 90 fire damage in a 2-tile radius.

march_order.name: Radetzky March
march_order.description: Strike up the march: every ally within 8 tiles gets +35% speed and +25% damage for 10s.

call_frontier.name: Call the Frontier
call_frontier.description: The Ban calls the Military Frontier: 4 Grenzer fight beside him for 60s.

dead_queens_call.name: The Dead Queen's Call
dead_queens_call.description: Heals every undead ally within 7 tiles for 200.
